# Quantum Error Correction Progress Report

Recent demonstrations in surface code topologies have achieved logical qubit error rates surpassing the physical fault-tolerance threshold.
TSMC and IBM joint fabrication efforts demonstrated a 40 percent reduction in crosstalk noise across adjacent superconducting transmons.
According to Nature Quantum Reviews, commercial fault-tolerant architectures are projected to achieve practical utility by 2029.
Overall coherence stability remains the primary bottleneck for continuous multi-hour quantum simulations.
